2131-2511--5.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Repeat.

678-4192-4247-5659-5753.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-4192-4247-5659-5753.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

222-527-2079-3899.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2079-3899.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

275-5078-5901.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
275-5078-5901.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Artist's Talent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1987-2187-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2187-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2187-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3532-4928-5078-7650.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-4928-5078-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Forgotten Ancient triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

3259-4302-4509-7175.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
3259-4302-4509-7175.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

2178-5147-7185-7284.description:
Cast Belonging by paying {5}{W}.
When Belonging enters, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Shapeshifter creature tokens with changeling.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Belonging.
When Belonging dies, Rat King triggers, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Rat King by tapping it and sacrificing the Shapeshifters.
When the Shapeshifters die, Rat King triggers three times, untapping Rat King.
Resolve the Rat King ability from step 5, returning Belonging from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4585-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

856-3263-5315-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

339-413-677-1849.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1563-2457-6441-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

104-4186-4506.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-4506.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1770-4124-5954-6763.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

359-813-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Warp and Acrobatic Maneuver.
359-813-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp and Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

5471-6217.notablePrerequisites:
Obeka has power greater than or equal to five minus the number of filibuster counters on Azor's Elocutors.
Obeka does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5471-6217.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Obeka.
Obeka triggers, causing you to get that many upkeep steps after this one.
Move to your first upkeep step.
Azor's Elocutors triggers, putting a filibuster counter on it and causing you to win the game if it has five or more filibuster counters on it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining upkeep step as needed.

1636-3490-5805.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
1636-3490-5805.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield, which enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Intruder Alarm and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat from step 2.

856-2034-4321-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2034-4321-5477.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 green Plant creature token and a Food artifact token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

851-1354-1835-4275.notablePrerequisites: Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
851-1354-1835-4275.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.

3398-4050-4700-5220.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven other nontoken Dinosaurs.
An opponent cannot block Gishath or Hellkite Charger.
3398-4050-4700-5220.description:
Declare Gishath and Hellkite Charger as attackers, triggering Hellkite Charger's ability.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven other nontoken Dinosaurs, adding {5}{R}{R}.
When the Dinosaurs die, Mortuary triggers that many times, putting the Dinosaurs on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Gishath.
Gishath triggers, causing you to reveal the top seven cards of your library and put all Dinosaurs revealed this way onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

500-1308-2047-3129.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-1308-2047-3129.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

116-283-512.notablePrerequisites:
Kiora's Follower does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Kiora's Follower.
116-283-512.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, coping Kiora's Follower's ability, targetting the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Halo Fountain and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Kiora's Follower, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.

3936-4659-4680-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Core Prowler, adding {C}{C}.
Core Prowler dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Core Prowler trigger, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Core Prowler from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1548-2408-4526-5178.notablePrerequisites: An opponent that is unable to block and kill Port Razer controls a planeswalker with three or less loyalty counters on it.
1548-2408-4526-5178.description:
Activate Dovin by removing a loyalty counter from it, preventing all damage done to and done by an opponent's planeswalker with three or less loyalty counters on it until your next turn.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Odric triggers, giving creatures you control haste, trample and trample over planeswalkers until end of turn.
Declare Port Razer as an attacker, attacking the planeswalker targeted by Dovin in step 1.
Deal combat damage to the planeswalker's controller due to Port Razer's trample over planeswalkers.
Port Razer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

1462-5276.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling itself.
When Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

757-1719-4235.notablePrerequisites: Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
757-1719-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1367-2856-5261.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and shuffling it into your library.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting Mystical Tutor, putting Nexus of Fate on top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Draw Nexus of Fate from the top of your library.
Repeat.
